description: Native and browser measurements behind the "Where the kernel work went" section of docs/engine-execution.md (September 12, 2026). Cold jj --version with the jujutsu closure on a 9p share.

variants.6.1: Linux 6.1.187, rebuilt from the flake derivation with System.map kept.
variants.612: Linux 6.12.108 (pinned nixpkgs source) with the guest config; predates the 6.13 netfs collector and the 6.16 exec readahead change.
variants.7.2: Linux 7.2.5, rebuilt from the flake derivation with System.map kept (control).
variants.exec: 7.2.5 with the VM_EXEC branch of do_sync_mmap_readahead disabled (centred read-around restored).
variants.collect: 7.2.5 with netfs_wake_collector running the collector inline when in_task().
variants.nomitig: 7.2.5 with CONFIG_CPU_MITIGATIONS=n at build time (the guest already boots mitigations=off).

four_way.note: Fresh snapshots from the same native qemu, CPUs 88-91, NUMA node 5, alternating rounds. Wall time is quantised by the 0.25 s runner poll; compare browser CPU.

lts.note: Fresh snapshots from the same native qemu, CPUs 88-91, NUMA node 5, alternating rounds. Wall time is quantised by the 0.25 s runner poll; compare browser CPU. Rounds 2 and 3 overlapped plugin runs on other cores.

opencode.note: Fresh snapshots from the same native qemu, CPUs 88-91, NUMA node 5, alternating rounds. Wall time is quantised by the 0.25 s runner poll; compare browser CPU. Two rounds; the second 6.1 sample exited with status 4, the known intermittent opencode crash, and is excluded from the medians.
